scope.summary: Implement AI-assisted mask sources as an OPTIONAL StudioModelAdapter (14.23), local model preferred, no required cloud/account: Subject, Sky, Background, Landscape components, Objects (from a rough brush stroke or drawn rectangle), and People (per-person, with per-person component sub-masks such as skin, hair, clothing). When no adapter is present the masking system MUST degrade to the manual/range sources of MT-424 and surface a capability receipt rather than failing. AI-produced masks are the same StudioMask primitive and participate in compose/manage/review (MT-425).
acceptance_criteria: AI mask sources as optional adapter; degrades to manual with capability receipt; no cloud dependency
expected_tests: test: AI sources produce StudioMask when adapter present; per-person component sub-masks
negative: no adapter installed -> degrades to manual/range + capability receipt (no failure)

target_entries: Studio / Camera Raw & Develop / Masking — AI sources (optional)

risk_if_missed: AI masks become a hard cloud dependency or crash without adapter.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
